title: Does CoT Monitoring Advantage Depend on Monitor Language Matching Agent Language?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Addresses a critical gap: global deployments involve cross-lingual monitoring. If translation degrades monitoring accuracy, this is a systematic safety gap affecting billions of non-English users. High-stakes finding either way.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires running DeepSeek-R1-8B on translated MALT tasks, managing Chinese CoT, setting up translation pipelines, and running monitors in two languages. The multilingual pipeline complexity is substantial for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two conditions (same-language vs. cross-lingual monitoring) on translated tasks. Conceptually clean, but the translation setup, multilingual model handling, and evaluation could stretch beyond 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
